text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: ERA5 variables and CAMS irradiance on three days'

g.text: Figure 2: ERA5 variables and CAMS irradiance on three days

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One NGED solar farm, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Three days at one farm, chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index of its daylight hours: the clearest (highest mean), the most variable (highest spread), and the dullest (lowest mean). Clear-sky index: measured irradiance divided by the irradiance expected under a cloudless sky. Only days with at least 5 daylight hours in the rows count.'
text.tspan: One NGED solar farm, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS:
Three days at one farm, chosen by the CAMS clear-sky index of its daylight hours: the clearest (highest mean), the
most variable (highest spread), and the dullest (lowest mean).
Clear-sky index: measured irradiance divided by the irradiance expected under a cloudless sky.
Only days with at least 5 daylight hours in the rows count.
